messages:
maria (eng-platform): quick sync — thinking about a hybrid approach for edge: proto-first internal, but JSON-over-gRPC / rest fallback at the gateway for external clients. pros/cons?
kevin (eng-runtime): hmm. proto-first keeps typed contracts and avoids transcoding cost. but fallback adds complexity at gateway + more paths to test. :thinking:
sam (eng-sre): my main worry is quotas & retries. if gateway transparently transcodes, how do we handle token/quota attribution? header mapping might break current per-route quotas.
yasmin (eng-telemetry): also tracing gets hairy. spans might be lost if we do HTTP<->gRPC transcode inside the gateway. we need consistent trace IDs and sampling.
maria (eng-platform): agree. proposal: gateway should emit a normalized telemetry envelope and propagate X-Redwood-Trace/ctx header. Quota mapping: gateway attaches original route metadata in X-Original-Route header for control plane.
kevin (eng-runtime): sample gateway config idea: 
```yaml
edge:
  accept: [json, grpc-web]
  backend: proto://model-service:50051
  fallback_mode: passthrough|transcode
  preserve_headers: [authorization, x-request-id, x-redwood-trace, x-original-route]
```
kevin (eng-runtime): if fallback_mode=passthrough we route JSON to a thin adapter which speaks REST -> proto, so main runtime stays proto-native. less run-time transcode CPU.
sam (eng-sre): can we avoid an adapter per route? that adds deployment surface. maybe a shared translation sidecar that handles many models. health checks + circuit-breakers important.
yasmin (eng-telemetry): for telemetry, gateway should emit both "client-facing" and "internal" spans. also add a small shim that tags telemetry with translation=true so we can alert on increased latencies from transcode.
maria (eng-platform): rollout plan idea: start with opt-in for a single public route, enable json fallback behind a feature flag, canary 5% traffic, measure latency delta, failure modes. If helpful, create quick RFC.
kevin (eng-runtime): agree. quick check: what about streaming? gRPC streaming -> http chunked streaming fallback is messy. maybe disallow streaming fallback; require grpc-web for streaming clients.
sam (eng-sre): +1, streaming paths should be explicit. fallback only for unary calls.
maria (eng-platform): ok action items: maria to draft RFC (proto-first + transcode opt-in), kevin to prototype sidecar adapter, yasmin to sketch telemetry envelope and sampling, sam to list SRE checks. tagging @deploy-bot to create a canary workspace.
deploy-bot: created canary env: canary-2026-proto-fallback (id: canary-6141). Use this for initial tests. :shipit: 
kevin (eng-runtime): awesome — i'll push a minimal PoC this week and link to the RFC. follow-up in #eng-platform tomorrow at 10am.
yasmin (eng-telemetry): I'll add a dashboard widget to surface transcode latency tail.
maria (eng-platform): thanks all — feel free to drop short notes in this thread as you make progress.
